title: Sanyu Goes to Market
subtitle: Sanyu's Growing Heart
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Sanyu goes to Jinja market with Maama and learns about contentment when she sees beautiful hair ribbons.
keywords: contentment, market, family, Uganda, girls, character, virtue
dedication: For every little girl learning to find joy in what she has.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Sanyu sees something beautiful at the market and wants it so badly! But when Mercy does something unexpected, Sanyu learns that giving brings more joy than getting.
